provenance.rendering: Current native NewsBlur app in an isolated simulator demo account; app UI is not reconstructed.
provenance.screenshot_dataset_revision: Capture operator must verify the dataset revision used; file presence alone does not establish it.

render_protocol.viewport: Use each export expected dimensions as the exact viewport and capture only the rendered panel at scale 1.
render_protocol.native_locale: English uses root captures; every other locale requires captures/localized/<language>/<device>-<view>.png. Never fall back to English.
render_protocol.encoding: Canonical export filenames require real PNG bytes; verify encoding before submission.
render_protocol.device_frame: Use raw capture at exact screen_opening below the unmodified official bezel. No added device shadow.
render_protocol.direction_07: Same-capture inset at 300% inset width, approximately 1.5 times the complete-device screen scale; separate by a 4% canvas-width gap. iPad crop needs review when captures arrive.
